units.source_text: 但是，河流下游有好几个小镇，岛村不晓得到哪个镇上去才好。

en.t: But there were several small towns downstream along the river, and Shimamura did not know which one he ought to go to.

units.source_text: 他又不是想去看正在发展成纺织工业区的大镇，因此索性在一个冷落的小站上下了车。

en.t: Since he had not come to see the large town that was developing into a textile industrial district, he simply got off at a lonely little station.

units.source_text: 走了一会儿，就到了一条像是古代驿站集中的市街上。

en.t: After walking for a while, he came out onto a town street that seemed to belong to an old post-station settlement.
